hero.description: Software Engineer with experience designing end-to-end web applications. 6+ years transforming technical challenges into robust technological solutions.

about.p1: My name is Lewis Garcia. My journey in programming began in my childhood with C++. Today, I specialize in architecting and developing complex integration solutions and SaaS platforms.
about.p2: I graduated with honors as a Computer Engineer and currently share my expertise as an Adjunct Professor at Universidad de Oriente. I am passionate about transforming technical challenges into elegant, robust software solutions.
about.p3: My most ambitious projects include a high-performance flight booking platform that unifies providers with different processes, and IoT control systems for the oil and gas industry.

Developed custom e-commerce applications and headless Shopify solutions using Node.js and React, featuring custom back-offices and embedded Power BI dashboards.
Automated stadium access control systems by programming Python-based micro-controllers integrated with a digital ticketing platform serving 293K users across Venezuela.

items.title: IoT Systems & Cloud Integration

Maintained an ASP.NET data management application and analysis dashboards for a portfolio of 10 active oil wells.

Developed various websites, including blogs and product stores, focusing on performance and scalability.
